title: The Legend of the Red Ring

scenes.text: Why did the Xbox 360 display a red ring in 2009?
Many think the red ring was caused by a faulty power supply alone.
scenes.label: Power supply only myth
scenes.query: Xbox 360 power supply red ring myth

scenes.text: In reality it was a combination of overheating, lead‑free solder cracks and GPU stress that triggered the error code.
scenes.label: Overheat and solder cracks
scenes.query: Xbox 360 overheating lead free solder issue
scenes.query2: Xbox 360 GPU stress red ring cause

scenes.text: Keep it cool, replace thermal paste!
scenes.label: Cool it down
scenes.sub: Regular cleaning and new paste prevent the ring.

scenes.text: Follow for daily tech you should actually know.
